title: Convert scripts/test-* to node:test and run them with one runner
description:
84 scripts/test-* files (58 .ts, 11 .cjs, 13 .mjs) each import node:assert/strict and print 'passed'; they are chained with && in package.json test:ci:ts. No isolation, no reporting, no parallelism, first failure hides the rest. About 65 need only a three-line node:test wrapper with zero behaviour change (sampled: test-inline-excerpt.ts, test-site-env.ts, test-robots-policy.ts, test-blog-feature-solver.ts). The hard class is the .cjs scripts, six of which carry a private copy of a hand-rolled TypeScript require hook (registerTypeScriptRequire in scripts/register-papyrus-aliases.cjs, test-theme-packs.cjs and others); convert them to .ts under tsx, which already honours tsconfig paths.

Fix: wrap each script in import { test } from 'node:test'; move them to tests/unit/**/*.test.ts (or keep the path, but use one glob); replace the && chain with node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=4 'tests/**/*.test.ts'; delete the six require-hook copies. Also move features/operator-cli.feature to features_backend/ (its steps exist only in Python, so cucumber-js hits undefined steps) and collapse the three byte-identical cucumber profiles in cucumber.js to one.

Done when: npm test runs every former test:* target through the runner with per-test reporting, and CI calls that one command.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
